T: Breakfast with Katy's family. Then the dragon.
D: A San Francisco valet is pulled back into the world of his father's secret organisation.
P: Serve the mains when Shang-Chi and Katy have breakfast with her family.
S: Jasmine rice porridge, ginger, chicken and fried shallots. Shaun eats here daily.

Rice simmered slowly in chicken stock with ginger until creamy, topped with shredded chicken, spring onion, soy, sesame oil and fried shallots. Rinse 200g jasmine rice and put in a big pot with 2L chicken stock and a 5cm piece of sliced ginger. Bring to the boil, then simmer gently, stirring often, for 1 hour until thick and creamy. Poach 2 chicken breasts in the congee for the last 20 minutes, then shred. Ladle into bowls and top with the chicken, sliced spring onion, soy, a few drops of sesame oil and fried shallots.
Hoisin honey roast pork in steamed buns with cucumber, spring onion and peanuts

Pork scotch fillet roasted with hoisin and honey until sticky and charred, sliced into soft steamed bao with cucumber, spring onion and peanuts. Marinate 800g pork scotch fillet in 4 tbsp hoisin, 2 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp soy and 2 crushed garlic cloves for 2 hours. Roast at 200C for 35 minutes, basting with the marinade twice, until sticky and charred at the edges. Rest and slice thinly. Steam 12 frozen bao buns for 8 minutes. Fill with pork, thin cucumber sticks, sliced spring onion and crushed peanuts.
mince and chopped shellfish with ginger, steamed in bamboo, chilli oil, before the scaffolding fight

Pork and prawn dumplings with ginger and spring onion, steamed in bamboo baskets and served with chilli oil and black vinegar. Mix 300g pork mince with 200g finely chopped peeled prawns, 1 tbsp grated ginger, 2 sliced spring onions, 1 tbsp soy, 1 tsp sesame oil and a pinch of white pepper. Put a heaped teaspoon on each of 30 round dumpling wrappers, wet the edges and pleat closed. Steam in a paper-lined bamboo basket over boiling water for 8 minutes. Serve with chilli oil and black vinegar.
M: Whole snapper steamed with ginger and spring onion, soy and sizzling oil, rice and bok choy

Whole snapper steamed with ginger and spring onion, finished with hot oil and soy, with rice and stir-fried greens. Score a 1.2kg whole snapper and steam over sliced ginger and spring onion for 12 minutes. Top with fresh spring onion, pour over 3 tbsp soy, then 4 tbsp smoking hot oil. Serve with 300g jasmine rice and bok choy.
Valet night beef and broccoli noodles
wok-seared rump, garlic, greens and glossy oyster sauce, after parking cars all night

Beef strips seared hot in a wok with garlic and broccoli, tossed with egg noodles and oyster sauce until glossy, served in takeaway boxes. Slice 500g rump thinly and toss with 1 tbsp soy and 1 tsp cornflour. Soak 400g egg noodles as the pack says. Sear the beef in a very hot wok with oil in 2 batches and remove. Stir-fry 1 head broccoli in florets and 3 sliced garlic cloves for 2 minutes with a splash of water. Add the noodles, beef, 4 tbsp oyster sauce and 1 tbsp soy and toss until glossy.
W: Silky mango and evaporated milk pudding topped with mango slice scales
Mango purée warmed with sugar and gelatine, stirred into evaporated milk, set in glasses for 4 hours, topped with thin mango slices laid like scales.
K: Katy's brown sugar boba milk tea
Black milk tea with chewy tapioca pearls in brown sugar syrup

Chewy tapioca pearls cooked in dark brown sugar syrup, swirled up the glass in tiger stripes, with cold milk tea and ice. Cook 150g tapioca pearls as the pack says and drain. Simmer 100g dark brown sugar with 60ml water for 3 minutes, add the pearls and cook 2 minutes more until sticky. Brew 3 black tea bags in 300ml boiling water, then chill. Spoon the pearls and syrup into 4 glasses and swirl up the sides. Add ice, then 600ml cold milk mixed with the tea. Serve with fat straws.
